operations.content: This repo develops and ships the memory-bank Claude Code skill, which gives an agent a persistent per-project memory in a memory-bank/ folder: project context plus lessons stored as root → delta chains with helpful/harmful counters

The skill content (SKILL.md, references/*.md, scripts/ Python, templates) is the product; the repo around it is the wrapper (tooling, tests, docs, CI). Skill content changes only on purpose or for a real bug, never as incidental rewording
Private project maintained by Ash; GitHub repo memory-bank-skill (private), with main for releases and develop as the working branch
Python 3.8+ standard library only, no third-party dependencies, for both the skill and the repo tooling; there is no requirements file or pyproject
skill/memory-bank/ must stay self-contained: it has to work when symlinked or unzipped into ~/.claude/skills/memory-bank, so it may not reference files outside itself
Python standard library only (argparse, json, pathlib, unittest, zipfile); CI tests on Python 3.9 and 3.12, local dev on 3.12
GitHub Actions workflow CI runs make test then make validate on every push and pull request, matrix Python 3.9 and 3.12, fail-fast off
make test runs python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v from the repo root (12 tests in tests/test_memory.py); override the interpreter with PYTHON=...

make smoke runs scripts/smoke.sh: init, apply --dry-run, apply, find, validate in a mktemp dir using tests/fixtures/smoke-ops.json, then asserts the IDs are on disk; prints FAIL and exits 1 on any error
make validate runs scripts/check_schema.py (parses all JSON, checks tests/fixtures/*-ops.json against ops.schema.json, confirms known-bad batches are rejected) and then the smoke run

make install symlinks skill/memory-bank to ~/.claude/skills/memory-bank; make install PROJECT=<path> targets <path>/.claude/skills; make uninstall removes only a symlink pointing at this repo; refuses real directories
make package writes dist/memory-bank-<git describe>.zip with memory-bank/ as the top folder (caches excluded); make clean removes dist/ and __pycache__

memory.py finds the bank via --bank PATH, else env var MEMORY_BANK_DIR, else the nearest memory-bank/ walking up from cwd; from this repo root that is the dogfood bank, so tests and smoke always pass --bank

Repo layout: skill/memory-bank/ (the skill), tests/ (test_memory.py, evals.json, fixtures/), scripts/ (repo tooling, not the skill's scripts), docs/ (design notes), memory-bank/ (this repo's own bank), .github/workflows/ci.yml

Skill: SKILL.md picks a mode (init, load, record, maintain) and points to references/<mode>.md; scripts/memory.py is the CLI; scripts/hooks.py serves SessionStart/Stop/PreCompact hooks; assets/templates seed a new bank

scripts/lib: ops.py runs batches, store.py does file IO, IDs, snapshots and rollback, entry.py parses entry lines, search.py does keyword find and duplicate similarity, budget.py holds limits, safety.py scans for secrets

Writes go agent → JSON operations batch → memory.py apply: the whole batch is validated (atomic, nothing written on any error), snapshotted to .snapshots/, merged into entry files, logged to ops-log.jsonl, and index.md is regenerated
memory.py and hooks.py resolve every path from Path(__file__), so the skill runs unchanged through a symlink or from a zip extract; keep new skill code on that pattern
ops.schema.json is documentation only and no skill script loads it; scripts/check_schema.py implements just the keywords it uses and fails if the schema adopts an unsupported keyword
Unit tests import the CLI by putting skill/memory-bank/scripts on sys.path (never by editing the skill) and drive memory.main() against a temp bank via --bank
Behavioural changes to the skill need a matching check: script behaviour → unit test in tests/test_memory.py; agent instructions in SKILL.md or references/ → eval in tests/evals.json
Branches feat/*, fix/*, docs/* off develop; main holds tagged releases vX.Y.Z; Conventional Commits (feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, build, ci, chore); run make test and make validate before pushing

When a budget, operation or entry format changes, update references/spec.md and scripts/schemas/ops.schema.json in the same change; the scripts are authoritative, and user-visible changes go under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md
Chose symlink install over copying so edits in skill/memory-bank take effect immediately; make package covers sharing without the repo
Kept references/research-basis.md inside the skill rather than moving it to docs/, because SKILL.md links to it; docs/README.md points to it instead
0.1.0: skill moved to skill/memory-bank, evals to tests/, Makefile and repo scripts, README/CHANGELOG/CONTRIBUTING/LICENSE, CI, and this dogfood bank
Review the dogfooding rough-edge list from the 0.1.0 setup session and decide which skill changes to make; each needs a test or eval per CONTRIBUTING.md
The workspace's .claude/skills/memory-bank is a separate real-directory copy of the skill; replace it with make install PROJECT=<workspace root> once it has been removed, so there is one source
tests/evals.json holds 3 agent-level evals with no runner in this repo; decide how to run them (skill-creator eval flow or a script) and wire them into a make target
The skill claims Python 3.8+ but nothing tests 3.8: CI covers only 3.9 and 3.12, and setup-python on ubuntu-latest may no longer ship 3.8
